question: In a multiplayer game, an opponent who controls Tajuru Preserver can't sacrifice a creature for Only Blood Ends Your Nightmares. Do they discard two cards instead?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: each opponent who can't sacrifice a creature, because they control none or control Tajuru Preserver, discards two cards, and they have no choice.
expected.answer: Each opponent who can sacrifice a creature must do so, and thus won’t discard any cards. Each opponent who can’t sacrifice a creature (either because they don’t control any, or because they control Tajuru Preserver) will wind up discarding two cards. Your opponents have no choice in the matter.
